title: Donald Hornig listed as present at Kecksburg

tellings.quote: And I discovered that I had found a document about the Kexsburg UFO, and Donald Horn was listed as being present.

plain: Kevin Knuth, a physicist and former NASA researcher, says he came across a government summary of the 1965 Kecksburg incident, when an object was reported to have come down near Kecksburg, Pennsylvania. He says the document listed Donald Hornig, a senior government scientist, as being present, which would tie high-level science officials to the event.
